Other activities

Voluntary initiatives and science activism

#ScienceForUkraine

The world changed on 24 February 2022. Two days after Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, I opened a Twitter account to collect information about international support available to Ukrainian scholars and students. Together with colleagues, I developed this initiative into #ScienceForUkraine. Within a week, the initiative had become an international volunteer organisation involving more than 100 people from 30 countries. #ScienceForUkraine represents collective strength, empathy and the wish to help. Since 2 August 2023, #ScienceForUkraine has been a registered NGO in Latvia. I am part of its leadership team.

Find out more about #ScienceForUkraine on ourwebsite, Twitter, Facebook, LinkedInand other social media.

You can also read the report on the first three months of #ScienceForUkrainehere. 

Citizen science in Latvia

Citizen science is a field in which I have been actively involved since 2014, when the digital archive garamantas.lv was established and we began developing public engagement initiatives. In autumn 2023, I was nominated as Latvia’s citizen science ambassador by the European Citizen Science Association. Together with other researchers, I have been developing the Facebook page “Citizen Science in Latvia” and working to make citizen science better known and more widely used in research.

NEP4DISSENT

From 2020 to 2022, I served as science communication coordinator for the COST Action Nep4Dissent (CA16213). I gained valuable practical experience by following and reporting on a dynamic research network, creating “Blog4Dissent”, conducting in-depth interviews with outstanding scholars and undertaking other activities.
